description: Queen S1c step (c): second even eigenvector of R_e = A_e - P_e (zeta window form minus pole; S87 hp_forms.py, ZETA), basis b_j(s) = sqrt((2j+1)/L) P_j(2s/L - 1), s = log x in [0,L], extended evenly to [-L,L] (even sector); coefficients are in this orthonormal basis with metric L^2(ds) on [0,L] (half the L^2[-L,L] norm: multiply by 1/sqrt(2) for unit norm on [-L,L]). Half-width L, primes n <= e^{2L}. Sign of eigenvector arbitrary. HIGH-PRECISION NUMERICAL (mpmath dps 120; dps 170 check identical to 29+ digits at (L,N)=(1.0,64),(1.2,48),(2.0,48)). Eigenvalues for L >= 1.1 are NOT converged in N (upper bounds only); eigenvectors there are Ritz vectors of unconverged eigenvalues. RH OPEN.
